fields.summary_ko.0: SanDisk (SNDK) stock surged 7.5% today, with positive analysis from Lynx Equity easing concerns about weak memory chip demand.
fields.summary_ko.1: SanDisk is trading at 6.4x trailing P/E, representing 33% undervaluation compared to Micron (MU), while Lynx provides a 12-month target for Micron of $1,325 (from $750).
fields.summary_ko.2: Micron has declined 17% over the past month and is in an 'extremely undervalued' state, with both SanDisk and Micron expected to benefit from expanding memory chip AI infrastructure demand.
